title: RunRecord
description: CANONICAL contract schema (v1.2.0) for a saved, immutable run record (Part 2: persistence, history, rerun). A record embeds the frozen RunConfig and RunResult schemas by reference and adds the persistence identity + timestamp. The record is app-controlled, so this schema is strict (additionalProperties: false). NOTE: JSON Schema cannot cross-compare values, so the invariant `id === config.id === result.runId` is enforced by makeRunRecord() and the test suite, not here. Validation requires the runconfig and runresult schemas registered in the SAME Ajv instance, plus ajv-formats (uuid, date-time). Changes only via the contract-change process in docs/engineering-workflow.md.

id.description: The run's UUID; equals config.id and result.runId. The record's stable key.

result.description: The RunResult, verbatim (including the complete raw blob).

savedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, stamped when the record was persisted.
